lines.zh: 我身子宽，走起来左右摆。
lines.en: Wide as I am, I sway as I walk.

lines.zh: 我在灰林的落叶上走，很轻。
lines.en: I walk the ashen woods' litter lightly.

lines.zh: 我绕过灰白的树干，树干很脆。
lines.en: I round pale trunks. They're brittle.
All four of my feet are nimble.

lines.zh: 我走上灰谷的斜坡，不费劲。
lines.en: I take the Ashen Valley slope without effort.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫着落叶，沙沙响。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 我朝有响动的地方走过去。
lines.en: I walk toward the sound.
I stop to check before going on.

lines.zh: 我步子很大，但落地很轻。
lines.en: Long strides, light landings.

lines.zh: 我从树后转出来，不惊动谁。
lines.en: I come around a tree without startling anyone.

lines.zh: 我贴着地走，鼻子一直在动。
lines.en: I walk low, nose working.

lines.zh: 我在两棵树之间来回走了两趟。
lines.en: I pace twice between two trees.
One leap clears the ditch.

lines.zh: 我坐在灰树下，耳朵转着。
lines.en: I sit under an ash tree, ears turning.

lines.zh: 我的皮毛上落了一层灰。
lines.en: A layer of ash lies on my coat.
I lick my forepaw.
The ground here is soft. Good for lying down.

lines.zh: 我听见灰林深处有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves deep in the ashen wood.
I draw my tail in close.
I open wide and all my teeth show.
I wait for someone to call me.

lines.zh: 没有主人在，我就自己转转。
lines.en: With no owner about, I wander on my own.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在前爪上，歇着。
lines.en: I rest my head on my forepaws.

lines.zh: 风把灰吹起来，我眯起眼。
lines.en: Ash blows up and I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我的毛很厚，不怕这里的凉。
lines.en: My coat is thick. The chill here doesn't reach me.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在枝上，我不动。
lines.en: A bird lands nearby. I don't move.
I remember my owner's hands. Warm.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵一直在转，听周围。
lines.en: My ears keep turning, listening.
You're looking at my teeth, aren't you.

lines.zh: 我这么宽，你别想绕过去。
lines.en: I'm this wide. You won't slip past.

lines.zh: 你的手放低点，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Lower your hands. I don't like that.

lines.zh: 你身上没有灰林的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell of the ashen wood.

lines.zh: 我可以跟你走，也可以不。
lines.en: I might follow you. I might not.
I'm reading whether you mean harm.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的耳朵就放松。
lines.en: You step back and my ears relax.

lines.zh: 你身上有另一种动物的味道。
lines.en: You carry another animal's scent.
My paws aren't yours to touch.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我闻闻就行。
lines.en: Stand still. I only want a sniff.
I'm this broad, and not from fat.
To have me follow, feed me first.

lines.zh: 你身上没有主人的记号。
lines.en: You bear no mark of my owner.
I'm waiting for one movement.
When I move, it's three blocks.

lines.zh: 你的靴子看起来不难咬。
lines.en: Those boots don't look hard to bite.

lines.zh: 我先看看，再决定跟不跟。
lines.en: I'll watch a while, then decide.

lines.zh: 你手指上有食物的味道。
lines.en: There's food smell on your fingers.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离，正好一扑。
lines.en: The gap between us is exactly one pounce.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看见我自己。
lines.en: I see myself in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我从喉咙里挤出一声，退开。
lines.en: A growl comes out and I step back.
That one hit me in the ribs.

lines.zh: 我的毛被血粘住了一撮。
lines.en: Blood has matted a patch of my coat.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，把灰尘抖掉。
lines.en: I shake my head clear of the grit.
Hurt like this won't stop my legs.
I keep low and swing to your flank.
Ash sticks in the wound; it stings.

lines.zh: 伤在腿上，跑起来有点瘸。
lines.en: It's in my leg. I limp a little.
I'm waiting for you to come close again.
That made me warier.

lines.zh: 那块肉的味道，隔着风都闻到。
lines.en: I smell that meat on the wind.
Set it down and take three steps back.

lines.zh: 我可以跟你走，条件是你得喂我。
lines.en: I'll follow you, on the condition you feed me.

lines.zh: 肉味隔着风就到我这了。
lines.en: That meat smell reached me on the wind.

lines.zh: 这肉的味道很像主人给的。
lines.en: This meat smells like what my owner gave me.
Don't shake your hand. I'll misread it.
I lean in and sniff. Fresh.
I could finish it in one bite.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻你的手，没有咬。
lines.en: I sniff your hand and do not bite.
That much buys one measure of trust.
I'll follow this far and no farther.
Don't put your hand on my head.

lines.zh: 我吃完了，还是站在这儿。
lines.en: I've eaten, and I'm still standing here.
This food smells odd.

lines.zh: 你在等我自己过去，对吧。
lines.en: You're waiting for me to come to you.

lines.zh: 我不吃扔在地上的东西。
lines.en: I don't eat what's thrown on the ground.
Give me another and I'll think about it.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扣进泥里，稳住。
lines.en: My claws dig into the mud to steady me.

lines.zh: 我几乎没有退，只是转了身。
lines.en: I barely moved back. Only turned.
That disordered my coat.
Don't press against me. I'm covered in ash.
My foot got stepped on, I shift aside.
Now there's ash from me on your hand.
I give half a step to let you pass.
I sidestep, and you miss.
We clashed and neither gave way.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴甩到你腿上了。
lines.en: My tail whacked your leg.
I only know the one who feeds me.

lines.zh: 你没有灰林动物的气息。
lines.en: You have no scent of the ashen wood's beasts.
Let me smell your hands first.
I prefer lying under a tree.
That takes trust first.

lines.zh: 你别靠这么近，我不习惯。
lines.en: Not so close. I'm not used to it.
My coat is too thick for that.
Just don't move.
When the ash stops falling.
I haven't decided whether to follow you.
I take it and swallow.
I pin the meat under a paw.
I carry the bone along.

lines.zh: 东西太小，我找了一会儿。
lines.en: Too small. I hunted for it.
I bury it in the ash.

lines.zh: 那枚亮东西，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: That bright thing doesn't interest me.
There's my owner's scent on the ground.
Who would I carry this to?
A bit heavy. I drag it.
I eat and leave the bone.
I've watched your shadow a long while.
Something moves at the ashen wood's edge.
I sink down, and my forepaws move first.

lines.zh: 这地方有你在，就不安全。
lines.en: With you here, it isn't safe.
I've marked you. One step at a time.
The ash is deep. Your prints show.
I won't bark. That would spook you.
Behind you is the Ashen Valley slope.
I press my forepaws into the soil.
Ash from the ashen woods settles on my back.
I move through the ash without a sound.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我就换到侧面。
lines.en: You turn; I take your flank.
My nose stays pointed at you.
The faster you go, the wilder your prints.

lines.zh: 这地方的空地太窄，跑不开。
lines.en: The clearing's too narrow to run.

lines.zh: 你的脚一停，我的爪子也停。
lines.en: Your feet stop; my paws stop.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，从侧面包抄。
lines.en: I crouch low and circle around your flank.

lines.zh: 灰林的枝太脆，我一踩就断。
lines.en: Ashen branches snap under my step.
The wind's shifted. I'll come from the other side.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步子，一步一格。
lines.en: I count your paces, one to a block.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，四只脚一起用力。
lines.en: I pounce with all four legs.
This bite takes your forearm.

lines.zh: 我的爪子先按住你的膝。
lines.en: My paws pin your knee first.
I bite and hold.
You retreat. I don't chase far.

lines.zh: 我绕到你身后再扑一次。
lines.en: I circle behind and pounce again.

lines.zh: 你摔在灰里，我在你身上。
lines.en: You fell in the ash and I'm on you.

lines.zh: 这一下，你手里的东西脱了手。
lines.en: That knocked your grip loose.
You go behind a tree; I go around.

lines.zh: 我头一低，就顶到你的胸口。
lines.en: I drop my head into your chest.

lines.zh: 我从灰林的落叶里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the ashen litter.
I know the wind in Ashen Valley.
My coat is thick with ash.

lines.zh: 我在这棵枯树下歇了一夜。
lines.en: I rested a night under this dead tree.

lines.zh: 树影里走出一个宽身影。
lines.en: A broad shape steps out of the shade.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖毛，灰都飞起来。
lines.en: I shake and ash flies off me.

lines.zh: 我从灰堆里抖了抖身子。
lines.en: I shake myself free of the ash pile.
I walk slowly to the middle of the clearing.
My owner isn't here.
I circle half around the tree first.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的毛立刻卷起。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my coat curls at once.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，滚了一身灰。
lines.en: I slide down the slope and come up coated in ash.

lines.zh: 灰烬森林的猎手，也会淹。
lines.en: Even an Ashen Woods hunter can drown.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，灰全扬起来。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over and the ash bursts up.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的肩，扎得很深。
lines.en: Something bites deep into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 有股力按住我，我挣不动。
lines.en: A force pins me and I can't break it.
Hunger softens my legs and I slow.
Lightning strikes and my body convulses.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我四只脚都抓不住。
lines.en: The ground's gone; even my four feet find nothing.
